entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Here we are... Just two dudes[n]alone at an amusement park...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not like there's anything wrong[n]with that. Though I guess it'd[n]be better comin' with a girl...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whatever, I'm acceptin' my fate.[n]C'mon, let's get over to a roller[n]coaster! I'm ready to scream!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's all good. I'm totally used[n]to it after last time. You better[n]not cry on it, understand?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't worry, man. I'll be[n]there to protect you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, you tryin' to punish[n]me with that borin' shit?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Are you afraid? You are, aren't you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Phew... That shit was just[n]as thrillin' as always.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, my knees feel kinda weird.[n]Don't it feel like you're walkin'[n]on clouds or something?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh hey, when'd they get stuff[n]you gotta use your muscles for!?[n]C'mon, let's blow off some steam!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man... couples're freakin'[n]everywhere in this place...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wonder what they're[n]thinkin' about us...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Welp, guess it's time for[n]us loners to head home.
